items.question: What sacred and meritorious status is attributed to the three Pushkaras?
premises: The three Pushkaras are identified as a sacred ford.
The three Pushkaras are characterized as a holy place.
items.inference: The three Pushkaras constitute a site possessing both sacred-ford status and meritorious holiness.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation between tīrtham, puṇyā, and sthānam is compact and allows slight variation in parsing.
items.plain_english: The three Pushkaras are a sacred ford and a holy place.
